svg.title: British Columbia Environment / Conservation Officer cap crest
svg.desc: Clean authored reconstruction: smooth explicit geometry, outlined captions, and named native armorial components. Fine embroidered lettering, exact thread colours and stitch structure are not retained. Outlined type is a source-similar substitute. The visible framed historical achievement uses the selected native historical component; tiny original crest details cannot be authenticated.
